name: ai-photo-platform
description: AI Photo Sharing Platform for photographers and event studios

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@photo-platform/web & npm run dev --workspace=@photo-platform/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@photo-platform/shared-types --workspace=@photo-platform/validation --workspace=@photo-platform/config --workspace=@photo-platform/queues --workspace=@photo-platform/ai-client --workspace=@photo-platform/image-processing --workspace=@photo-platform/vector-store && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
